seo.title: Bashen Medical Programs — Integrated Care for Every Stage
seo.description: Specialized medical programs at Bashen Medical Complex in Sabya, Jazan: corporate wellness, home care, maternal & child health, chronic disease management, second opinion, telemedicine, and international patients. Apply online.

hero.title: Our Medical Programs
hero.subtitle: Comprehensive care packages designed for every age and condition — apply online and start your journey with our team.

cta.title: Didn't find the right program?
cta.subtitle: Our medical team is ready to design a personalized care plan for you or your family. Contact us and we'll help you choose the best fit.

executive-health.title: Executive Comprehensive Checkup Program
executive-health.tagline: A complete medical checkup in a single day, with a detailed report and consultant consultation.
executive-health.audience: Executives and adults over 35 seeking a thorough preventive checkup.
benefits: Over 60 lab tests and imaging studies
ECG, echo, and stress test as needed
Consultation with internal medicine and nutrition specialists
Detailed digital medical report and follow-up plan

corporate-wellness.title: Corporate & Employee Wellness Program
corporate-wellness.tagline: Medical agreements, pre-employment screening, and on-site clinics at your workplace.
corporate-wellness.audience: Companies, factories, government entities, and educational institutions.
benefits: Preferential rates for employees and their families
Pre-employment screening and annual fitness checks
Dedicated account management and unified monthly billing

home-care.title: Home Care Program
home-care.tagline: Complete medical and nursing care at home, supervised by a qualified team.
home-care.audience: Elderly patients, post-operative patients, and those with chronic conditions.

maternal-child.title: Maternal & Child Health Program
maternal-child.tagline: Pregnancy and delivery follow-up, childhood vaccinations, and growth & nutrition clinics.
maternal-child.audience: Pregnant women, new mothers, and children up to age 14.
benefits: Monthly pregnancy follow-up with an OB/GYN consultant

chronic-care.title: Chronic Disease Management Program
chronic-care.tagline: Ongoing follow-up for patients with diabetes, hypertension, asthma, and heart disease.
chronic-care.audience: Patients with one or more chronic conditions.
benefits: Individualized treatment plan with measurable goals
Remote monitoring of glucose and blood pressure readings
Nutrition and mental health consultations when needed

second-opinion.title: Second Medical Opinion Program
second-opinion.tagline: Review of your medical file by top consultants before making treatment decisions.
second-opinion.audience: Patients candidates for surgery or long-term treatment plans.
benefits: Full review of reports, imaging, and lab work

telemedicine.title: Telemedicine Program
telemedicine.tagline: Video consultation with a licensed consultant based in Saudi Arabia.
telemedicine.audience: Patients who prefer to consult from home or from outside Sabya.

international.title: International Patients Program
international.tagline: End-to-end service including medical coordination, translation, and accommodation.
international.audience: Patients traveling to the Kingdom for treatment or checkups.
benefits: Dedicated medical coordinator for each patient
